stops.name: Alain Prost
stops.source: https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/december-1986/15/formula-one-mexican-grand-prix-australian-grand-prix ('He came in as early as lap 32 for fresh rubber'); also https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/july-2004/142/race-86-australian-gp/
stops.note: puncture after clipping Berger; 8 laps before his planned stop

runningOrder.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1986_Australian_Grand_Prix: 'Mansell yielded the lead to Senna's Lotus at the second corner on lap 1 and fell behind both Piquet and Rosberg on the same lap. Piquet also overtook Senna on lap 1 to take the lead'; https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/december-1986/15/formula-one-mexican-grand-prix-australian-grand-prix: 'the McLaren in third place at the end of lap one was number two — Rosberg!'
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1986_Australian_Grand_Prix: 'Piquet charged back through the field, passing Mansell for second place on lap 44'
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1986_Australian_Grand_Prix: 'with 25 laps to go, all three championship contenders were running together in positions 2, 3 and 4'
runningOrder.note: 25 to go of 82 = after lap 57. The order of the three is worked out: Piquet second since lap 44; Prost 'closed on the two Williams cars' and 'had just passed Mansell for third' when Rosberg retired

runningOrder.source: https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/december-1986/15/formula-one-mexican-grand-prix-australian-grand-prix: 'Going into lap 63 the order was Rosberg, Piquet, Prost and Mansell.'
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1986_Australian_Grand_Prix: 'Piquet would make a late charge, closing the gap from 15.484 seconds with 2 laps remaining to just 4.205 at the finish'
runningOrder.note: 2 laps remaining of 82 = at the end of lap 80

notes: Piquet (#6) was called in for a precautionary tyre change 'soon after' Mansell's lap-64 tyre failure (Motor Sport Dec 1986; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1986_Australian_Grand_Prix) but no source read gives the lap: STORYLINE GAP. Goodyear then judged a non-stop run possible and the other runners stayed out. Rosberg (#2) retired lap 63 (tyre delamination), Mansell (#5) lap 64 (left-rear tyre).
